text:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout for `v4.1.0` to hosted endpoint (regions: us-west, eu-central, ap-south). Monitoring: embeddings similarity delta, p95 latency, error-rate. Auto-rollback=on.

emma: seeing a sharp drop in top-k cosine scores for embeddings in us-west canary. average similarity -0.12 vs baseline. A few customer queries returning lower relevance.

rafael: telemetry shows model variant `v4.1.0-qat` was accidentally routed to hosted canary in us-west instead of `v4.1.0-ptq`. That quantization mismatch could explain the vector drift.

katie: wait, dedicated customers were supposed to be pinned to `v4.0.5` during this window. If auto-rollback flips the hosted fleet, could it touch dedicated routing rules? ops-oncall?

ops-oncall: deploy-bot auto-rollback triggered for us-west at 5200000021: reason=embeddings-similarity-drop threshold=0.08. Started rollback to `v4.0.5-hosted`. No changes to dedicated pools, those remain pinned.

pm-ops: good catch. We need two parallel actions: 1) confirm dedicated unaffected, 2) stop cross-region propagation that might pin older artifacts to EU/AP by mistake.

emma: verified dedicated customer routing still pointing to `v4.0.5` and KMS keys/logs show no artifact promotion. Phew. However auto-rollback spilled over to the canary group and now eu-central shows minor drift too (likely cascading telemetry baselines).

rafael: proposal: keep hosted auto-rollback in us-west and eu-central only. Hold auto-rollback for ap-south and for dedicated pools. Also update the rollback rule to include artifact-variant guard (prevent qat->ptq cross-variant flips).

katie: +1. We should also make a quick release-note blurb and inform support. I'll draft. Can someone run the lock to prevent further automatic regional rollbacks from affecting dedicated?

ops-oncall: running lock commands.

``` 
redwoodctl rollout lock --scope dedicated --reason "protect dedicated pools during hosted embed drift" --by ops-oncall
redwoodctl rollout pause --region ap-south --by ops-oncall
```

deploy-bot: Locks applied. Auto-rollback remains enabled for hosted fleets in regions where regression exceeded thresholds. Suppressed in ap-south and for dedicated scope.

emma: after rollback in us-west, similarity scores back to baseline within 4m. eu-central improved after manual rollback there too. ap-south still on original artifact (no change) and stable.

rafael: created a quick hotfix plan: rebuild `v4.1.0` with correct quant config (`ptq`), push artifact `v4.1.0-ptq-build2`, run a 5% canary in ap-south then scale. ETA 12m. I'll own the build.

katie: I'll send the customer-facing note: "We detected a regional regression in embeddings relevance affecting hosted endpoint; a rollback was performed in affected regions and a patch build is being promoted. Dedicated customers were not impacted." Posting to status and pinging support & sales.

pm-ops: logging the decision and tagging @rafael for postmortem. Action items: tighten deploybot variant guards, add explicit scope flag to rollback rules, and add preflight artifact-variant check.

ops-oncall: If the patch is ready, let me know and I'll coordinate the controlled canary rollout. For now all dedicated pools remain locked.

deploy-bot: Thread closed after manual locks + regional rollback. If further anomalies appear, escalation will route to @ops-oncall and PM will notify customers.
